title: Drive analytics writes to ph/drive/... and ph/doc/... source paths, with four dimensions on drive metrics and three on document metrics
content:
The two shipped analytics processors partition the metric namespace by prefix, which is what makes `subscribeToSource` and `select` filters composable later.

**Sources** (the `source` field on each series value):

- `DriveAnalyticsProcessor` → `ph/drive/{documentId}/{branch}/{scope}`
- `DocumentAnalyticsProcessor` → `ph/doc/{documentId}/{branch}/{scope}`

**Dimensions on `DriveOperations`** — four of them:

| Dimension | Path shape |
| --- | --- |
| `drive` | `ph/drive/{documentId}/{branch}/{scope}/{revision}` |
| `operation` | `ph/drive/operation/{actionType}/{operationIndex}` |
| `target` | `ph/drive/target/{DRIVE\|NODE}/{targetId}` |
| `actionType` | `ph/drive/actionType/{CREATED\|DUPLICATED\|UPDATED\|MOVED\|REMOVED}/{targetId}` |

**Dimensions on `DocumentOperations`** — only three: `drive` (`ph/doc/drive/...`), `operation` (`ph/doc/operation/...`) and `target` (`ph/doc/target/...`). There is no `actionType`, because a generic document's action names are model-specific and cannot be bucketed into a fixed vocabulary.

Two things follow from the path design. First, `revision` (the operation index) is baked into the last segment of the `drive` dimension, so an un-truncated query yields one group per operation; you almost always want `lod: { drive: 1 }` to collapse back to per-drive. Second, `targetId` is the last segment of both `target` and `actionType`, so `lod: 1` on those gives you the type only, and full depth gives you per-node breakdowns — the same dimension serves both questions.

`targetId` resolution for node actions is a fallback chain in the shipped code — `input.id || input.targetId || input.srcFolder || documentId` — which is worth knowing when a `MOVE_NODE` row shows the source folder rather than the moved node.

Provenance: draft `04-Reference/04-Processors/_07-DriveAnalyticsHooks.md`; every path template and the dimension counts verified against `packages/shared/processors/drive-analytics/{drive,document}-processor.ts` at 6.2.2-dev.45. The draft's "Complete Dimensions Reference" lists four dimensions without noting that only drive metrics carry all four.
description: Sources are ph/drive/{driveId}/{branch}/{scope} and ph/doc/{documentId}/{branch}/{scope}; drive rows add an actionType dimension that document rows do not have.
